messages.text: Credit committee is tomorrow at 10. Need packages for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0203}}, {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0213}} and the two commercial renewals in the shared folder by 5 today so I can read them tonight.
Got it. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0213}} is basically done, just waiting on an updated pay stub. I'll have the memo drafted by 4.
Quick heads up: I refreshed the spreading for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0246}}. DSCR came in at 1.62x, up from 1.48x last year. Revenue is up and the term loan has amortized down nicely.
Nice. Did you normalize the owner distributions? Last year's number was dragged down by that one-time special distribution.
Yes, stripped out and footnoted on the spread tab. Even with it left in, DSCR is 1.41x, so still above covenant.

For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0203}}, committee is going to ask about the debt-to-income. It's at 41% with the new payment. Client has been with us since last October and the checking account shows steady direct deposit. Any concerns on exceptions?
41% is inside policy for medium risk, but I'd flag it as upper end. I'd rather present it as a clean approval with a note on deposit history than call it an exception.
Agree. Lynn, put the 6 months of deposit activity from {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00422}} in an exhibit. Committee likes seeing the cash flow, not just the ratio.
Closing side question: if {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0213}} gets approved tomorrow, can we close early next week? I need the final conditions list so I can order the title and insurance docs.
Only two conditions: verification of employment and the pay stub. I'll send you the list as soon as the memo is final. Next Tuesday should work.

Reminder for the commercial files: I want the latest financials and covenant compliance certificate for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}} in the package. Tammy is out tomorrow so someone needs to cover the presentation.
I can present {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0197}}. The compliance cert came in this morning, and I'll tie out the borrowing base with Brandi before 5.
Sounds good, Joshua. I'll send you my tie-out in the next hour so you have time to review.
